entities.summary: Jalin Daveon Hyatt is an American professional football wide receiver for the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tennessee Volunteers, where he won the Fred Biletnikoff Award and was voted a unanimous All-American in 2022 after setting program records for single-season and single-game touchdown receptions.
